        trail = max(r for r,c in moved)+1 if dr > 0 else min(r for r,c in moved)-1
        if 0 <= trail < h:
            out[trail] = [8]*w
        return out
    if guide_cols:
        gc = guide_cols[0]
        obj = [(r, c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w)
               if grid[r][c] != bg and c != gc]
        if not obj:
            return [row[:] for row in grid]
        color = grid[obj[0][0]][obj[0][1]]
        obj = [(r, c) for r, c in obj if grid[r][c] == color]
        cmin, cmax = min(c for r,c in obj), max(c for r,c in obj)
        dc = 1 if cmin > gc else -1
        shift = (gc + 1 - cmin) if dc > 0 else (gc - 1 - cmax)
        out = [[bg for _ in range(w)] for _ in range(h)]
        for r in range(h): out[r][gc] = grid[r][gc]
        moved = [(r,c+shift) for r,c in obj]
        for r,c in moved:
            if 0 <= c < w: out[r][c] = color
        trail = max(c for r,c in moved)+1 if dc > 0 else min(c for r,c in moved)-1
        if 0 <= trail < w:
            for r in range(h): out[r][trail] = 8
        return out
    return [row[:] for row in grid]
